_what: Frozen count of broad exception handlers that return nothing and say nothing (DSR-659).
_why_a_ratchet: Containment, not remediation. Almost all of this is upstream code that re-syncs from mims-harvard:main, so rewriting it would conflict on every sync. The count may fall, never rise.
_how_to_lower_it: Make the handler tell the caller what failed -- return or assign something naming the error, status or reason -- or re-raise. Adding a log does not count: server logs are not the agent's channel.
_how_to_waive_one: Put '# silent-swallow: <reason>' inside the handler. The reason is required. Optional-dependency probes need no pragma; a try block that only imports is exempt structurally.
_note: The ticket's figure of 245 across 110 modules did not reproduce. The corpus has grown, and treating logging as transparent counts the log-and-fall-through shape that a literal reading of 'reduces to pass' misses.
